name: More Cases
teaser: Expand your organizational possibilities with more cases added to your stash!
description_html:
Description

Add new cases and containers to your stash, each with its own item filters!
All of them are available from various traders, with both barter and money offers.

Keep in mind that most of them are intended to be difficult to obtain.

Details and availability
Container Type of storageInternal sizeB

Download the file, extract its content somewhere and drop the user folder and all its content inside the SPT folder.
There should be randomizzatore-morecases-x.x.x inside the user/mods folder.

Backward and mods compatibility
Backward compatibility

I’ve ensured that the old containers will still be available in your stash if you previously downloaded and installed version 1.0.0.

For the sake of consistency, I’ve updated their descriptions to recommend upgrading to the new containers.

You can delete them and get your money back by using the Commando friend chat, or simply sell them to the traders.

Or keep them… it’s up to you!

Mods compatibility

As far as I know, there shouldn’t be any conflicts with other mods.

Remember to report any issues in the support thread.

Planned features
Planned features
  • T H I C C Magazine case
  • GIGACHAD Item case (this will be an experimental container with enormous size (14+ x 14+), report any issues with the interface)
  • More variants of the same containers
  • Config options: size, item filters, trader assorts and availability
  • And more as I think about it…
